SAP Security Patch Day

The security maintenance of installed SAP software is key to continuously protect also against new types of attacks or newly identified potential weaknesses.

Based on feedback from customers, partners and SAP user groups, SAP has launched a regular SAP Security Patch Day, scheduled for the second Tuesday of every month — which has been synchronized with the Security Patch Day of other major software vendors.

On these SAP Patch Days, SAP publishes software corrections as SAP Security Notes, focused solely on security to protect against potential weaknesses or attacks. Access SAP Security Notes in SAP for Me(opens in new tab), then select All Security Notes, to get the complete list of all SAP Security Notes. We recommend that you implement these corrections at a priority. Several tools are available to help identify, select and implement these corrections.

SAP categorizes SAP Security Notes as Patch Day Security Notes and Support Package Security Notes, with the sole purpose of making you focus on important fixes on patch days and the rest to be implemented automatically during SP upgrades. For details refer to the SAP Security Notes FAQ. Security fixes for SAP NetWeaver based products are also delivered with the support packages.

Since June 11, 2019, the following rule is in place:

  • SAP will deliver fixes for new SAP Security Notes with high or very high severity
  • only for Support Packages shipped within the respective last 24 months*
  • if the product version for which that Support Package has been shipped is still in Mainstream or Extended Maintenance.

As a rule, releases going into Customer-Specific Maintenance will be considered in the first 12 months for notes with high priority (CVSS >= 7.0) which also applies for Support Packages shipped within the last 24 months. Please see SAP Note 3053725 for more information.

Notes with low or medium priority contain corrections in at least the newest support package in all mainstream and extended maintenance releases.

*For information on areas with an exception from the 24 months maintenance strategy, refer to the SAP Security Notes FAQ.
